leadIn.title: Lead-In & Context: Adverbs of Manner
leadIn.content: Listen to the music: Sarah plays the piano beautifully and speaks English clearly. Adverbs of manner tell us how someone does an action.

meaningCheck.question: Function check: What is the primary purpose of using Adverbs of Manner?
options: To express clear, level-appropriate meaning in structured context
To translate sentences word-for-word from another language
It is an obsolete form never used by native speakers
meaningCheck.explanation: Correct · This structure provides explicit grammatical function and clarity.

meaningCheck.question: Form check: Does correct usage of Adverbs of Manner require matching subject, verb, and modifier agreements?
options: No, agreement rules are optional in English
Yes, matching grammatical forms ensures natural, accurate communication
Agreement only matters in formal academic writing
meaningCheck.explanation: Correct · Accurate form and agreement choices prevent misunderstandings.

form.title: Form & Structure: Adverbs of Manner
form.content: Adjective + -ly (quick -> quickly, careful -> carefully). Irregular forms: good -> well, fast -> fast, hard -> hard.

pronunciation.title: Pronunciation Notes: Adverbs of Manner
pronunciation.content: Spoken stress, weak forms, intonation, and articulation patterns for Adverbs of Manner.

controlledPractice.question: Adverb of 'careful'?
controlledPractice.explanation: Most adjectives simply add -ly: careful → carefully.

controlledPractice.question: Adverb of 'good'?
controlledPractice.explanation: Good → well is an irregular adverb.

controlledPractice.question: Fix: 'She sings beautiful.'
controlledPractice.explanation: An adverb (not adjective) is needed to describe how she sings.
